svg.title: Order events
svg.desc: {"kind":"diagram","description":"[Checkout](#producers.checkout) publishes one event per order. Each consumer reads [the orders topic](#broker.orders) at its own pace, so a slow [warehouse load](#consumers.analytics->warehouse[0]) never delays [the confirmation email](#consumers.notify->mail[0])."}

g.title: Kafka
g.desc: {"kind":"element","path":"broker","label":"Kafka","caption":"durable log","description":"Topics keep events for 7 days. A consumer that falls behind resumes from its last committed offset."}

g.title: Kafka → Consumers
g.desc: {"kind":"lifted","from":"broker","to":"consumers","edges":[{"kind":"edge","edge":"(broker.captured -> consumers.analytics)[0]","from":"broker.captured","to":"consumers.analytics"},{"kind":"edge","edge":"(broker.captured -> consumers.fulfillment)[0]","from":"broker.captured","to":"consumers.fulfillment","label":"consumes","description":"Fulfillment waits for both events before it ships."},{"kind":"edge","edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.analytics)[0]","from":"broker.orders","to":"consumers.analytics"},{"kind":"edge","edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.fulfillment)[0]","from":"broker.orders","to":"consumers.fulfillment","label":"consumes"},{"kind":"edge","edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.notify)[0]","from":"broker.orders","to":"consumers.notify","label":"consumes"}]}
